description.en: Draft one personalized delivery message for one or more artifacts, let you edit it, then send it to one or more contacts on the chosen channel and mark all included artifacts as sent. Never sends without approval of the final message.

warp.bot: Use this to deliver one or more ready artifacts in a single message to one or more contacts. Pass artifactIds as a comma-separated list. Prefer integration=email unless the contact wants another channel. Pass contactIds (comma-separated) for recipients; if omitted, unique contacts attached to the artifacts are used. Optional subject query/input sets the email subject (prefer this over inventing one). Drafts a message, then a single approve step (editable); auto mode continues without waiting. Same approval model as campaigns. Never wrap the message body in quotation marks. In German always use informal du/dein (never Sie/Ihr/Ihnen). For monthly site reports, draft a warm briefing tone that names one concrete highlight.

description.en: One or more artifact IDs, comma-separated

en: Draft and send one email for several finished artifacts
Deliver slides and a demo link to a client in a single editable message
de: Eine E-Mail für mehrere fertige Artefakte entwerfen und senden
Folien und Demo-Link in einer editierbaren Nachricht an einen Kunden liefern

en.question: Can I deliver multiple artifacts at once?
en.answer: Yes. Pass several artifact IDs (comma-separated). One message is drafted and sent; all included artifacts become sent.

en.question: Does it send automatically?
en.answer: No. A draft is generated first; the final message must be approved before send.

en.question: What happens after send?
en.answer: One delivery record is created per recipient, all included artifacts become sent with deliveredAt set, and messaging logs a contact activity per recipient.

en.question: Who receives the message?
en.answer: Pass contactIds (comma-separated; one id is fine). If omitted, unique contacts attached to the artifacts are used. Email/SMS/WhatsApp uses each contact’s email or phone.

de.question: Kann ich mehrere Artefakte auf einmal liefern?
de.answer: Ja. Übergib mehrere Artefakt-IDs (kommagetrennt). Es wird eine Nachricht entworfen und gesendet; alle enthaltenen Artefakte werden sent.

de.question: Wird automatisch gesendet?
de.answer: Nein. Zuerst entsteht ein Entwurf; die finale Nachricht muss vor dem Versand freigegeben werden.

de.question: Was passiert nach dem Versand?
de.answer: Pro Empfänger entsteht ein Delivery-Eintrag, alle enthaltenen Artefakte werden sent mit deliveredAt, und Messaging loggt pro Empfänger eine Kontakt-Aktivität.

de.question: Wer empfängt die Nachricht?
de.answer: Übergib contactIds (kommagetrennt; eine ID reicht). Fehlt das, werden die eindeutigen Kontakte an den Artefakten genutzt. E-Mail/SMS/WhatsApp nutzt E-Mail oder Telefon jedes Kontakts.

warp.bot: Use for delayed welcome/drip journeys. Prefer prop onboarding-stage=done. Actions: wait | warp | branch | halt. Contact messages: warpId joai-contact-message-send with Hook-style inputs. Campaigns remain for newsletters/backfill. Requires Automations native app.

inputs.name: Trigger type
inputs.bot: prop (contact property), segment, manual (run_automation only), webhook (inbound Hook enroll), or site_monthly_report (when a monthly website report is delivered).

inputs.name: Trigger config
inputs.bot: For prop: {"propKey":"onboarding-stage","propValue":"done"}. For segment: {"segmentId":"…"}. For webhook: {"source":"stripe"} (inbound Hook source query param). For site_monthly_report: {}.

inputs.name: Actions
inputs.bot: Ordered JSON. Types: wait {delayMinutes}, warp {warpId, inputs}, branch {when[], thenPosition, elsePosition}, halt {}. Example contact message: {"type":"warp","config":{"warpId":"joai-contact-message-send","inputs":{"contactId":{"source":"contact","path":"contact.id"},"message":{"source":"literal","value":"Hallo {{name}}"},"subject":{"source":"literal","value":"Hi"},"integration":{"source":"literal","value":"email"},"recipientId":{"source":"contact","path":"contact.email"}}}}. Wait uses delayMinutes only (0 = immediate). Multiple warps allowed.

inputs.name: Agent ID
inputs.bot: Agent UUID. Required for webhook triggers and when warps need a sending agent (e.g. joai-contact-message-send). The agent must have the channel configured. There is no team-wide fallback.
